text: わりいが　はやいとこ　みてきて　くれよ！

structure.en: go take a look for me!

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a statement means 'but', here softening a request. わりい is a rough way to say わるい. わりいが = 'sorry, but'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くれ is a blunt man's way of asking someone to do something for him. みてきてくれ = 'go and look for me'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる means going to do it and then coming back. みてきて = 'go take a look and come back'.
